# KPI dictionary

Every KPI shown in the application, the report centre and the BI layer is defined once in `backend/apps/analytics/kpis.py`. Period KPIs use an inclusive range of plant-local dates, evaluated as the half-open interval `[00:00 date_from, 00:00 date_to + 1 day)`; periods that include today are clipped at the current time. Snapshot KPIs describe the current state.

| KPI | Code | Unit | Period | Definition | Formula | Source | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Registered assets | `total_assets` | assets | snapshot | Equipment assets in the register that are not archived (retired). | `COUNT(asset) WHERE archived_at IS NULL` | assets.EquipmentAsset |  |
| Equipment out of service | `assets_unavailable` | assets | snapshot | Non-archived assets whose current status is Out of Service or Under Maintenance. | `COUNT(asset) WHERE status IN (OUT_OF_SERVICE, UNDER_MAINTENANCE)` | assets.EquipmentAsset (status is synchronised from open downtime events) |  |
| Total downtime | `downtime_hours` | h | period | Equipment-hours of downtime falling inside the period, summed over assets. Events crossing the period boundary are clipped; ongoing events count up to now. | `SUM over events of overlap([started_at, COALESCE(ended_at, now)), period)` | maintenance.DowntimeEvent (source of truth for downtime; never typed as a duration) | Overlapping events on one asset are rejected, so no hour is counted twice for an asset. Hours on different assets add up (5 h on two assets = 10 equipment-hours). |
| Unplanned downtime | `unplanned_downtime_hours` | h | period | Downtime hours from events of type 'Unplanned - equipment failure'. | `downtime_hours WHERE downtime_type = UNPLANNED_FAILURE` | maintenance.DowntimeEvent |  |
| PM compliance | `pm_compliance_pct` | % | period | Share of preventive/inspection tasks due in the period that were completed on or before their due date plus the configured grace days. A task enters the denominator once its compliance deadline has passed, or earlier if it is already completed. | `100 x COUNT(PM WO due in period, COMPLETED, completion local date <= due_date + grace) / COUNT(PM WO due in period WHERE due_date + grace < today OR status = COMPLETED)` | maintenance.WorkOrder with schedule IS NOT NULL | Cancelled tasks stay in the denominator (counted as not compliant) so cancelling cannot inflate compliance. Not reported when no task was due. |
| Open work orders | `open_work_orders` | work orders | snapshot | Work orders in Reported, Assigned, In progress or Awaiting verification. | `COUNT(WO) WHERE status IN open statuses` | maintenance.WorkOrder |  |
| Overdue work orders | `overdue_work_orders` | work orders | snapshot | Open corrective work orders past their planned completion time, plus open preventive tasks past due date + grace days. | `COUNT(open WO WHERE (schedule IS NULL AND planned_end < now) OR (schedule IS NOT NULL AND due_date + grace < today))` | maintenance.WorkOrder | Corrective work orders without a planned completion time cannot be overdue. |
| Maintenance expenditure | `maintenance_cost` | currency | period | Actual costs dated in the period that are linked to a work order or an asset (parts issued, labour, contractors, repairs). | `SUM(expense.amount) WHERE cost_type = ACTUAL AND (work_order IS NOT NULL OR asset IS NOT NULL)` | costs.OperationalExpense (single cost ledger) | Parts are costed when issued, not when purchased, so purchases are never counted twice. Returns post negative credits. |
| Total operating expenditure | `operating_cost` | currency | period | All actual costs dated in the period. | `SUM(expense.amount) WHERE cost_type = ACTUAL` | costs.OperationalExpense |  |
| Low-stock items | `low_stock_items` | items | snapshot | Active inventory items whose stock on hand is at or below the reorder point (all criticalities). | `COUNT(item) WHERE active AND current_stock <= min_stock_level` | inventory.InventoryItem |  |
| Critical spares low | `critical_stock_items` | items | snapshot | The subset of low-stock items classified as critical spares. | `low_stock_items WHERE criticality = CRITICAL` | inventory.InventoryItem |  |
| Approved output | `primary_output` | metric unit | period | Sum (or average, per the metric's aggregation) of the plant's primary output metric on APPROVED reports dated in the period. | `SUM(measurement.value) WHERE metric.is_primary_output AND report.status = APPROVED` | operations.OperationalMeasurement | Missing values are excluded, never treated as zero; the number of reports lacking a value is shown. |
| Output vs target | `output_vs_target_pct` | % | period | Approved primary output as a percentage of the target for the same approved reports. | `100 x SUM(value) / (COUNT(reports with a value) x metric.target_value)` | operations.OperationalMeasurement, operations.MetricDefinition | Not reported when the metric has no target. |
| Open incidents | `open_incidents` | incidents | snapshot | Operational incidents that are Open or Under investigation. | `COUNT(incident) WHERE status != RESOLVED` | operations.OperationalIncident |  |
| Pending approvals | `pending_approvals` | items | snapshot | Items waiting for a decision: submitted operational reports, submitted purchase requests, work orders awaiting verification and pending overtime records. | `COUNT(reports SUBMITTED) + COUNT(PR SUBMITTED) + COUNT(WO AWAITING_VERIFICATION) + COUNT(overtime PENDING)` | operations, inventory, maintenance, workforce |  |
| MTTR | `mttr_hours` | h | period | Mean Time To Repair: average duration of closed unplanned-failure downtime events that ended in the period. | `AVG(ended_at - started_at) WHERE downtime_type = UNPLANNED_FAILURE AND ended_at IN period` | maintenance.DowntimeEvent | Not reported without at least one closed failure event. Measures restoration time (failure to return to service), including waiting time. |
| MTBF | `mtbf_hours` | h | period | Mean Time Between Failures: equipment uptime in the period divided by the number of failures that started in the period. | `(assets_in_scope x elapsed period hours - downtime_hours) / COUNT(failure events started in period)` | maintenance.DowntimeEvent, assets.EquipmentAsset | Not reported when there were no failures. Flagged as low-confidence below 3 failures. Assets commissioned or archived mid-period are counted for the whole period (approximation). |
| Breakdowns | `failure_count` | failures | period | Unplanned-failure downtime events that started in the period. | `COUNT(event) WHERE downtime_type = UNPLANNED_FAILURE AND started_at IN period` | maintenance.DowntimeEvent |  |
| Repeat failures | `repeat_failure_pct` | % | period | Share of failures in the period that occurred on an asset within the repeat-failure window (setting) of that asset's previous failure. | `100 x COUNT(failures with previous failure on same asset within N days) / failure_count` | maintenance.DowntimeEvent |  |
| Work-order completion rate | `wo_completion_rate_pct` | % | period | Of the work orders reported in the period and not cancelled, the share completed so far. | `100 x COUNT(WO reported in period, COMPLETED) / COUNT(WO reported in period, status != CANCELLED)` | maintenance.WorkOrder |  |
| Average repair cost | `avg_repair_cost` | currency | period | Average total actual cost (all dates) of corrective work orders completed in the period. | `SUM(actual expenses of those WOs) / COUNT(corrective WOs with actual_end in period, COMPLETED)` | maintenance.WorkOrder, costs.OperationalExpense | Not reported when no corrective work order was completed. |
| Stock valuation | `stock_valuation` | currency | snapshot | Value of stock on hand at weighted-average cost. | `SUM(current_stock x unit_cost) over active items` | inventory.InventoryItem |  |
| Stock turnover (annualised) | `inventory_turnover` | turns/yr | period | Net value issued in the period divided by the average of opening and closing stock value, scaled to a year. | `(net issue value / ((value at start + value at end) / 2)) x 365 / period days` | inventory.StockTransaction (stock value at a time = cumulative ledger value) | Not reported for periods under 28 days or when average stock value is zero. |
| Goods received value | `purchase_spend` | currency | period | Value of goods received against purchase orders in the period (quantity x order price). | `SUM(receipt_line.quantity x po_line.unit_price) WHERE received_at IN period` | inventory.GoodsReceiptLine | This is inventory acquisition, not maintenance expense. Open-order value is a commitment. |
| Open purchase commitments | `open_commitments` | currency | snapshot | Value of quantities ordered but not yet received on issued purchase orders. | `SUM((qty_ordered - qty_received) x unit_price) WHERE PO status IN (ISSUED, PARTIALLY_RECEIVED)` | inventory.PurchaseOrderLine |  |
| Average supplier lead time | `supplier_lead_time_days` | days | period | Average days from order date to full receipt for purchase orders fully received in the period. | `AVG(local date(fully_received_at) - order_date)` | inventory.PurchaseOrder | Not reported when no order was fully received in the period. |
| Maintenance cost per output unit | `cost_per_output_unit` | currency / output unit | period | Maintenance expenditure divided by approved primary output in the same period and scope. | `maintenance_cost / primary_output` | costs.OperationalExpense, operations.OperationalMeasurement | Not reported when output is missing or zero. |
| Actual vs budget | `budget_variance` | currency | period | Actual costs minus budget for the period. Monthly budgets are prorated by the number of period days that fall in each month. | `SUM(actual) - SUM(budget.amount x days_in_period_and_month / days_in_month)` | costs.OperationalExpense, costs.Budget | Positive variance = overspend. |

## Alert rules

| Rule | Code | Default severity | Default parameters | Logic |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Abnormal or excessive downtime | `EXCESSIVE_DOWNTIME` | WARNING | ongoing_hours=8, max_hours=24, window_days=7 | An outage longer than `ongoing_hours`, or more than `max_hours` of downtime on one asset within the last `window_days` days. |
| Overdue preventive maintenance | `PM_OVERDUE` | WARNING | critical_after_days=7 | A schedule-generated work order is still open after its due date plus the PM grace period. Becomes critical after `critical_after_days`. |
| Upcoming scheduled maintenance | `PM_UPCOMING` | INFO | — | A preventive task that has not started is due within its schedule's reminder threshold. |
| Overdue work orders | `WO_OVERDUE` | WARNING | — | An open corrective work order has passed its planned completion time. |
| Critical spare-part shortage | `CRITICAL_STOCK` | WARNING | — | A spare classified as critical is at or below its reorder point. Critical severity when out of stock. |
| Low stock | `LOW_STOCK` | INFO | — | A standard item is at or below its reorder point. |
| Pending approvals | `PENDING_APPROVAL` | INFO | report_hours=12, other_hours=24 | Operational reports waiting longer than `report_hours`, or purchase requests / work-order verifications waiting longer than `other_hours`. |
| Incomplete shift reporting | `MISSING_SHIFT_REPORT` | WARNING | lookback_days=3 | An expected shift report is missing or still in draft after its deadline, within the last `lookback_days`. |
| Operational metric outside threshold | `METRIC_THRESHOLD` | WARNING | lookback_days=7 | A submitted or approved measurement within the last `lookback_days` is outside the metric's alert range. |
| Unusual or rapidly increasing expenses | `EXPENSE_ANOMALY` | WARNING | lookback_days=30, large_multiplier=3, min_amount=1000, mom_increase_pct=50 | An invoice-type actual expense of at least `min_amount` exceeds `large_multiplier` x its category's 180-day median, or a category's month-to-date spend is `mom_increase_pct`% above the average of the same days in the previous three months. |

## Reports

| Report | Code | Permission | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| Daily operations report | `daily_operations` | `reports.view` | Shift reports with all metric values in the period. Users without full access see approved reports only. |
| Shift handover report | `shift_handover` | `employees.view` | Handover notes and acknowledgements. |
| Staffing coverage | `staffing_coverage` | `employees.view` | Assigned headcount versus minimum staffing per shift. |
| Overtime report | `overtime` | `overtime.view` | Overtime hours and approved cost. |
| Asset status report | `asset_status` | `assets.view` | Current status of every registered asset, with downtime in the period. |
| Maintenance history | `maintenance_history` | `workorders.view` | Work orders completed in the period with actions and costs. |
| Downtime analysis | `downtime_analysis` | `assets.view` | Downtime events overlapping the period; hours are clipped to the period. |
| Preventive-maintenance compliance | `pm_compliance` | `workorders.view` | Each scheduled task due in the period and whether it counted as on time. Rows marked NOT_YET_DUE are excluded from the KPI. |
| Work-order performance | `work_order_performance` | `workorders.view` | Work orders reported in the period with response and repair times. |
| Inventory and stock movements | `stock_movements` | `inventory.view` | The stock ledger for the period. |
| Inventory status | `inventory_status` | `inventory.view` | Stock on hand, valuation and reorder status (snapshot). |
| Procurement report | `procurement` | `procurement.view` | Purchase orders placed in the period with receipt status and lead time. |
| Cost report | `maintenance_cost` | `costs.view` | All actual cost-ledger entries dated in the period. |
| Executive KPI summary | `executive_kpi_summary` | `dashboard.view` | Headline KPIs for the period with their definitions. |

## BI datasets (schema `bi`)

| View | Description |
|---|---|
| `bi.dim_date` | Calendar dimension 2020-2032 with fiscal year. |
| `bi.dim_plant_unit` | Plant units with their plant. |
| `bi.dim_department` | Departments (-1 = Unassigned). |
| `bi.dim_asset` | Equipment assets (-1 = No asset). |
| `bi.dim_employee` | Employees without contact details or pay rates. |
| `bi.dim_maintenance_type` | Maintenance types. |
| `bi.dim_cost_category` | Cost categories. |
| `bi.dim_inventory_item` | Inventory items with current stock and valuation. |
| `bi.dim_supplier` | Suppliers. |
| `bi.dim_metric` | Operational metric definitions. |
| `bi.dim_shift` | Shift definitions. |
| `bi.fact_operational_measurements` | Approved operational measurements (report x metric). |
| `bi.fact_work_orders` | Work orders with timing, overdue and PM-compliance flags. |
| `bi.fact_downtime_events` | Downtime events (whole events). |
| `bi.fact_downtime_daily` | Downtime split by local calendar day (use for date-sliced totals). |
| `bi.fact_inventory_transactions` | Stock-ledger movements. |
| `bi.fact_operational_costs` | Cost-ledger rows. |
| `bi.fact_budget_daily` | Budgets prorated per day. |
| `bi.fact_purchase_receipts` | Goods-receipt lines with value. |
| `bi.fact_alerts` | Alerts with status and age. |
